SolvedQuestion.title: SolvedQuestion
SolvedQuestion.description: A solved quiz or study question with structured AI answer badge, concise explanation, subject tag, confidence score, and flashcard bookmark state. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for createdAt and updatedAt.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the question owner.

questionText.description: Extracted or typed question text (1..4000 characters).

answerBadge.description: Concise answer badge shown in the floating Dynamic Island (e.g. 'B', 'A, C', 'True', '42.5', '1-C, 2-A').

shortAnswer.description: Short answer phrase shown in Split Pill and Flashcards (0..300 characters).

explanation.description: Concise 2-line step-by-step explanation or formula breakdown (0..2000 characters).

subject.description: Subject domain used for solving and filtering.

language.description: Detected language of the source question (e.g. 'English', 'Hindi', 'Spanish').

translatedQuestion.description: Optional English translation when source question is in another language.

bookmarked.description: Whether the user starred this question for quick study review.

mistakeDeck.description: Whether this item is included in the active Liquid Glass Mistake Flashcard Deck.

createdAt.description: Immutable creation timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Last modification timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/solvedQuestions/{questio.description: Per-user private collection of solved questions, explanations, bookmarks, and mistake flashcards.
